blocks.en: Understand the seven Documentation Requirements for a parametric release process, especially documenting the load monitor description and the CPP acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 理解參數放行失敗時的處理原則——為何「通過的無菌試驗結果不能推翻參數放行失敗」
blocks.en: Understand the principle for handling a parametric release failure, and why a passing sterility test result cannot overrule a parametric release failure

blocks.zh: 掌握不同送件途徑 (Filing Requirements)：原始申請、Prior Approval Supplement、Special Report/Annual Report 的適用條件
blocks.en: Understand the different Filing Requirements: when to use an original application, a Prior Approval Supplement, or a Special Report/Annual Report

blocks.zh: 認識本 Guidance 引用的關鍵參考文獻及其在參數放行實務中的定位
blocks.en: Recognize the key references cited in this guidance and their place in parametric release practice

blocks.en: III.C Documentation for Parametric Release Process

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 七項文件要求的邏輯架構：
blocks.en: Logical structure of the seven documentation requirements:

blocks.zh: 滅菌週期描述引用：不需要在參數放行申請中重複整個驗證報告，但必須提供可追溯的引用連結
blocks.en: Reference to the sterilization cycle description: You do not need to repeat the entire validation report in the parametric release application, but you must provide a traceable reference link

blocks.zh: CPP 鑑別與限度：每個 CPP 都要有 min/max limits，且必須在已驗證範圍內
blocks.en: CPP identification and limits: Every CPP must have min/max limits, and they must be within the validated range

blocks.zh: 放行原則聲明：這是最關鍵的承諾——CPP 合格即放行，CPP 不合格即拒收，無菌試驗結果不能「推翻」CPP 失敗
blocks.en: Release principle statement: This is the most critical commitment: if the CPPs are met, the batch is released; if the CPPs are not met, the batch is rejected, and the sterility test result cannot "overrule" a CPP failure

blocks.zh: 無菌合規聲明：即使採用參數放行，任何依照法定方法進行的無菌試驗仍必須合格（穩定性試驗、上市後調查等）
blocks.en: Sterility compliance statement: Even when parametric release is used, any sterility test performed by the compendial method must still pass (stability testing, post-marketing investigations, etc.)

blocks.zh: Load Monitor 描述：四個面向——類型、使用方法、測量功能、位置理由
blocks.en: Load Monitor description: Four aspects: type, use and analysis, functions measured, and rationale for location

blocks.zh: 控制系統文件：驗證負載已暴露於滅菌製程的控制系統（如 PLC 邏輯、聯鎖裝置等）
blocks.en: Control system documentation: Verification that the load exposed to the sterilization process is under a control system (such as PLC logic and interlocks)

blocks.zh: CoA/批次紀錄修訂：放行記錄上必須反映參數放行的方法，並連結到申請書中的承諾
blocks.en: CoA/batch record revisions: The release record must reflect the parametric release method and link to the commitments in the application

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 第三項要求（無菌試驗不能推翻 CPP 失敗）是整個參數放行哲學的基石。想像你通過了一個嚴格的建築安全檢查系統——所有結構計算、材料測試、施工監控都到位。如果最後有一項結構參數不合格（例如鋼筋間距超標），你不能因為「建築看起來沒有裂縫」就說它是安全的。「看起來沒問題」（無菌試驗合格）不能推翻「結構參數不合格」（CPP 失敗）。反之，如果所有結構參數都合格，你不需要在每面牆上鑽洞來證明內部完好。
blocks.en: The third requirement (a sterility test cannot overrule a CPP failure) is the cornerstone of the entire philosophy of parametric release. Imagine you have passed through a rigorous building safety inspection system, with all structural calculations, material tests, and construction monitoring in place. If one structural parameter fails at the end (for example, rebar spacing exceeds the limit), you cannot declare the building safe because "the building shows no cracks". "It looks fine" (a passing sterility test) cannot overrule "the structural parameter failed" (a CPP failure). Conversely, if all structural parameters pass, you do not need to drill holes in every wall to prove the inside is sound.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「不能推翻」原則的實務意涵：這意味著如果一批產品的 F₀ 值低於接受標準（例如某探針記錄的 F₀ = 11.8 min，標準為 ≥ 12 min），即使你隨後對該批進行無菌試驗且結果合格，仍然「不能放行」。唯一的出路是 reprocessing（重新滅菌）——前提是你有已核准的 reprocessing 程序且能證明重新滅菌不會影響產品品質 **(PDA TR30, Section 6.3)**。
blocks.en: Practical meaning of the "cannot overrule" principle: If the F₀ value of a batch is below the acceptance criterion (for example, a probe records F₀ = 11.8 min against a criterion of ≥ 12 min), the batch still "cannot be released" even if you then run a sterility test on it and the result passes. The only way out is reprocessing (resterilization), provided you have an approved reprocessing procedure and can show that resterilization does not affect product quality **(PDA TR30, Section 6.3)**.

blocks.zh: Load Monitor 的四面向描述：FDA 要求非常具體。例如對 Class 5 化學指示器，你需要說明：(1) 品牌和型號（類型）；(2) 放入滅菌鍋何處、滅菌後何時讀取、判讀標準為何（使用和分析）；(3) 該指示器測量的是「等效於特定 BI 生長/無生長結果的時間-溫度整合效應」（測量功能）；(4) 放在已鑑定的 cold spot 位置的科學理由（位置理由）。
blocks.en: The four-aspect description of the Load Monitor: FDA expects very specific detail. For a Class 5 chemical indicator, for example, you need to state: (1) brand and model (type); (2) where it is placed in the sterilizer, when it is read after sterilization, and the reading criteria (use and analysis); (3) that it measures "the time-temperature integrated effect equivalent to a specific BI growth/no-growth result" (functions measured); (4) the scientific rationale for placing it at the identified cold spot (rationale for location).

blocks.zh: Class 5 vs. Class 3 指示器：Class 5 (Integrating Indicator) 的反應曲線與 BI 高度相關，適用於大多數情境。Class 3 (Specific Test Indicator) 僅在特定條件下反應，FDA 允許「在某些情況下」使用，但明確表示 Class 5 是推薦的標準選擇 **(USP <1222>, Section 4.3)**。
blocks.en: Class 5 vs. Class 3 indicators: The response curve of a Class 5 (integrating indicator) correlates closely with that of a BI and is suitable for most situations. A Class 3 (specific test indicator) responds only under specific conditions; FDA allows its use "in some circumstances" but clearly states that Class 5 is the recommended standard choice **(USP <1222>, Section 4.3)**.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一批產品的滅菌記錄顯示：8 支溫度探針中有 7 支的 F₀ ≥ 15 min，但 1 支探針記錄 F₀ = 14.2 min（接受標準為 ≥ 15.0 min）。你會如何處理此批次？能否以「多數探針合格」為由放行？
blocks.en: The sterilization record of a batch shows that 7 of 8 temperature probes had F₀ ≥ 15 min, but 1 probe recorded F₀ = 14.2 min (acceptance criterion ≥ 15.0 min). How would you handle this batch? Can it be released on the grounds that "most probes passed"?

blocks.zh: FDA 要求 load monitor 描述必須涵蓋四個面向。請為你所熟悉的化學指示器撰寫這四個面向的描述。
blocks.en: FDA requires the load monitor description to cover four aspects. Write the description of these four aspects for a chemical indicator you are familiar with.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 要求「無菌試驗結果不能推翻參數放行失敗」？這個原則背後的科學邏輯是什麼？如果一位品質主管堅持「我們做了無菌試驗且合格，應該可以放行」，你如何說服他？
blocks.en: Why does FDA require that "a sterility test result cannot overrule a parametric release failure"? What is the scientific logic behind this principle? If a quality head insists that "we ran the sterility test and it passed, so we should be able to release", how would you persuade him or her?

blocks.zh: CDMO 將現有產品從傳統無菌試驗放行切換到參數放行時，CoA 和批次紀錄需要哪些具體修改？修改前需要走什麼法規途徑？
blocks.en: When a CDMO switches an existing product from sterility test release to parametric release, what specific changes are needed to the CoA and batch records? What regulatory pathway must be followed before making these changes?

blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.en: Example content of a CDMO parametric release CoA:

blocks.en: After the switch to parametric release, the sterility section of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) should be changed to:

blocks.zh: IV. Filing Requirements 送件要求
blocks.en: IV. Filing Requirements

blocks.zh: 三種送件途徑：
blocks.en: Three filing pathways:

blocks.zh: 原始申請 (Original Application)：在 NDA/ANDA/BLA 初次送件時即納入參數放行。將參數放行資訊與滅菌驗證數據、放行標準一起提交。
blocks.en: Original Application: Parametric release is included when the NDA/ANDA/BLA is first submitted. The parametric release information is submitted together with the sterilization validation data and the release criteria.

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS, 事前核准補件)：已核准產品要從傳統放行轉換到參數放行時的標準途徑。必須「FDA 核准後才能實施」——這是明確的事前核准要求。
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS): The standard pathway for converting an approved product from traditional release to parametric release. It "may be implemented only after FDA approval", which is an explicit prior approval requirement.

blocks.zh: Special Report / Annual Report（簡易途徑）：僅適用於已有相同場址、相同滅菌週期的參數放行經驗，且新產品的製程條件（容器、裝載、週期參數、接受標準）完全落入現有已驗證範圍內。
blocks.en: Special Report / Annual Report (simplified pathway): Applies only when there is existing parametric release experience at the same site with the same sterilization cycle, and the process conditions of the new product (container, loading, cycle parameters, acceptance criteria) fall entirely within the existing validated range.

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement (事前核准補件)：依 21 CFR 314.70 規定，涉及「影響產品品質的製造方法重大變更」必須以 PAS 提出。從「無菌試驗放行」轉為「參數放行」顯然屬於此類。FDA 審查後核准，申請者才能開始使用參數放行。
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement: Under 21 CFR 314.70, a "major change in the manufacturing method that affects product quality" must be submitted as a PAS. Switching from "sterility test release" to "parametric release" clearly falls into this category. The applicant can begin using parametric release only after FDA reviews and approves it.

blocks.zh: 這三種途徑就像建築使用變更的三種情境：(1) 新建大樓申請時就規劃為餐廳（原始申請）；(2) 原本的辦公大樓要改成餐廳，需要重新申請使用執照（PAS——事前核准）；(3) 同一條商業街上你已經有一家餐廳，隔壁的相同格局店面也要開餐廳，只需要備查報告（Special Report——因為消防系統、通風系統、下水道等都是同一套已驗證的基礎設施）。
blocks.en: These three pathways are like three scenarios for a change in building use: (1) a new building is planned as a restaurant from the start when the application is filed (original application); (2) an existing office building is to be converted into a restaurant, which requires a new occupancy permit (PAS, prior approval); (3) you already have a restaurant on a commercial street and the identical unit next door will also become a restaurant, so only a notification report is needed (Special Report, because the fire protection, ventilation, and sewer systems are all the same validated infrastructure).

blocks.zh: 簡易途徑的條件極為嚴格：想走 Special Report/Annual Report 途徑，必須同時滿足：(1) 同一製造場址；(2) 相同滅菌週期（comparable sterilization cycle）；(3) 容器密封系統、裝載模式、週期參數、接受標準全部在現有驗證方案範圍內。實務上，這意味著同一款滅菌鍋、同類瓶型、同樣裝載配置。
blocks.en: The conditions for the simplified pathway are very strict: To use the Special Report/Annual Report pathway, all of the following must be met: (1) the same manufacturing site; (2) a comparable sterilization cycle; (3) the container closure system, loading pattern, cycle parameters, and acceptance criteria are all within the existing validation program. In practice, this means the same sterilizer model, the same type of vial, and the same loading configuration.

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略建議：對於多產品線 CDMO，最有效的策略是：第一個產品以 PAS 建立參數放行基礎（包含寬廣的裝載模式和容器範圍驗證），後續相似產品即可走簡易途徑。這需要在初始驗證方案設計時就預留擴展空間 **(PDA TR30, Section 7.1)**。
blocks.en: Recommended CDMO strategy: For a multi-product CDMO, the most effective strategy is to establish the parametric release foundation with the first product through a PAS (including validation of a broad range of loading patterns and containers), so that subsequent similar products can follow the simplified pathway. This requires building room for expansion into the initial validation program design **(PDA TR30, Section 7.1)**.

blocks.zh: 務必先聯繫審查部門：FDA 在最後一句明確建議：「contact the review division for your product to verify submission requirements」。這不是形式語言——在決定送件途徑前先與 FDA 溝通，可以避免送件後被要求重新以 PAS 提交的風險。
blocks.en: Always contact the review division first: In its last sentence, FDA clearly recommends: "contact the review division for your product to verify submission requirements". This is not boilerplate. Talking to FDA before deciding on the filing pathway avoids the risk of being asked to resubmit as a PAS after filing.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 目前有產品 A 已獲得 FDA 核准的參數放行。現在客戶 B 的產品使用相同滅菌鍋、相同瓶型(50 mL)，但裝載量從每批 5,000 瓶增加到 8,000 瓶（原驗證範圍為 3,000-6,000 瓶）。可以走 Special Report 途徑嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A CDMO has product A with FDA-approved parametric release. Client B's product now uses the same sterilizer and the same vial type (50 mL), but the load size increases from 5,000 vials per batch to 8,000 vials (the original validated range was 3,000-6,000 vials). Can the Special Report pathway be used? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 明確要求參數放行的變更必須「事前核准」(Prior Approval)？相較於其他製程變更可以走 Changes Being Effected (CBE) 的途徑，參數放行為何要求更高？
blocks.en: Why does FDA explicitly require that changes to parametric release be "Prior Approval"? Other process changes can use the Changes Being Effected (CBE) pathway, so why is the bar higher for parametric release?

blocks.zh: V. References 參考文獻
blocks.en: V. References

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 參考文獻導讀
blocks.en: Key Notes: Guide to the References

blocks.zh: 以下為 CDMO 實務人員最應深入研讀的核心參考文獻，依實務重要性排序：
blocks.en: The following are the core references that CDMO practitioners should study in depth, ranked by practical importance:

blocks.zh: 1. PDA Technical Report No. 30 (1999)：這是參數放行最完整的技術指引文件。涵蓋 overkill/bioburden-based approach 的選擇、F₀ 計算、load monitor 選型、滅菌週期開發的完整方法論。FDA 本 Guidance 可視為 PDA TR30 的法規配套文件 **(PDA TR30)**。
blocks.en: 1. PDA Technical Report No. 30 (1999): The most complete technical guidance document on parametric release. It covers the full methodology for choosing between the overkill and bioburden-based approaches, F₀ calculation, load monitor selection, and sterilization cycle development. This FDA guidance can be seen as the regulatory companion to PDA TR30 **(PDA TR30)**.

blocks.zh: 2. USP <1222> (2009)：美國藥典對參數放行的定義和技術要求。與 FDA Guidance 互為補充——FDA Guidance 告訴你「如何向 FDA 申請」，USP <1222> 告訴你「技術上該怎麼做」**(USP <1222>)**。
blocks.en: 2. USP <1222> (2009): The pharmacopoeial definition and technical requirements for parametric release. It complements the FDA guidance: the FDA guidance tells you "how to apply to FDA", and USP <1222> tells you "technically how to do it" **(USP <1222>)**.

blocks.zh: 3. ICH Q9 (2006)：風險評估的方法學框架。FDA 明確要求風險評估聲明須符合 ICH Q9 原則，因此 FMEA、FTA 等工具的運用不可或缺 **(ICH Q9(R1))**。
blocks.en: 3. ICH Q9 (2006): The methodological framework for risk assessment. FDA clearly expects the risk assessment statement to follow ICH Q9 principles, so the use of tools such as FMEA and FTA is indispensable **(ICH Q9(R1))**.

blocks.zh: 4. PIC/S PI 005-3 (2007)：PIC/S 的參數放行專項指引，尤其重要的是 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022 修訂版) Section 8 對最終滅菌的最新要求。CDMO 若有歐洲市場客戶，必須同時滿足 FDA 和 PIC/S 要求 **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.20–8.22)**。
blocks.en: 4. PIC/S PI 005-3 (2007): The PIC/S guidance dedicated to parametric release; of particular importance are the latest requirements for terminal sterilization in Section 8 of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022 revision). A CDMO with clients in European markets must meet both FDA and PIC/S requirements **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.20–8.22)**.

blocks.zh: 5. ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008：化學指示器的選型、使用和結果判讀標準。理解 Class 1–6 指示器的分級體系是正確選用 load monitor 的基礎。
blocks.en: 5. ANSI/AAMI/ISO 15882:2008: The standard for selection, use, and result interpretation of chemical indicators. Understanding the Class 1–6 indicator classification system is the foundation for choosing a load monitor correctly.

blocks.zh: 6. CPG 460.800 (1987)：FDA 最早接受參數放行的合規政策指引，為本 Guidance 的歷史先驅。瞭解其內容有助於理解 FDA 對參數放行的監管演進。
blocks.en: 6. CPG 460.800 (1987): The earliest FDA compliance policy guide accepting parametric release, and the historical precursor of this guidance. Knowing its content helps in understanding how FDA's oversight of parametric release has evolved.

blocks.zh: 這些參考文獻的關係就像蓋房子所需的各類文件：法規 (21 CFR) 是建築法規——你必須遵守；FDA Guidance 是向市政府提交建築許可申請的指南；PDA TR30 和 USP <1222> 是建築師手冊和工程規範——告訴你如何設計和施工；ICH Q9 是結構安全評估方法；PIC/S 是如果你的房子要在其他國家也合法使用時需要的「國際建築標準互認」。
blocks.en: The relationship among these references is like the documents needed to build a house: the regulations (21 CFR) are the building code, which you must obey; the FDA guidance is the guide for submitting the building permit application to the city; PDA TR30 and USP <1222> are the architect's handbook and engineering specifications, telling you how to design and build; ICH Q9 is the structural safety assessment method; and PIC/S is the "mutual recognition of international building standards" you need if your house is also to be legally used in other countries.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 要建立一套完整的參數放行系統，請排列你研讀這些參考文獻的優先順序，並說明理由。
blocks.en: If your CDMO is to build a complete parametric release system, rank these references in the order you would study them, and explain why.

blocks.zh: PDA TR30 (1999) 距今已超過 25 年。在此期間，PIC/S Annex 1 已於 2022 年大幅修訂。你認為 PDA TR30 中哪些內容可能需要更新以對齊 PIC/S Annex 1 的最新要求？
blocks.en: PDA TR30 (1999) is now more than 25 years old. In the meantime, PIC/S Annex 1 was substantially revised in 2022. Which parts of PDA TR30 do you think may need updating to align with the latest PIC/S Annex 1 requirements?

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時服務美國和歐盟市場的客戶。FDA Guidance 和 PIC/S PI 005-3 對參數放行的要求有哪些主要差異？如何設計一套同時滿足兩者的參數放行系統？
blocks.en: A CDMO serves clients in both the US and EU markets. What are the main differences between the requirements of the FDA guidance and PIC/S PI 005-3 for parametric release? How would you design a parametric release system that satisfies both?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 跨文獻關聯
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Cross-Reference Relationships

blocks.zh: 本 Guidance 的參考文獻展現了參數放行的「多層次法規架構」：
blocks.en: The references of this guidance show the "multi-layered regulatory architecture" of parametric release:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 七項文件要求：涵蓋滅菌週期引用、CPP 鑑別與限度、放行原則聲明、無菌合規聲明、load monitor 四面向描述、控制系統文件、CoA/批次紀錄修訂
blocks.en: Seven documentation requirements: Sterilization cycle reference, CPP identification and limits, release principle statement, sterility compliance statement, four-aspect description of the load monitor, control system documentation, and CoA/batch record revisions

blocks.zh: 不可推翻原則：無菌試驗合格結果不能推翻 CPP 不合格的判定——這是參數放行的哲學基石，違反此原則等於否定了參數放行本身的科學基礎
blocks.en: The "cannot overrule" principle: A passing sterility test result cannot overrule a CPP failure. This is the philosophical cornerstone of parametric release, and violating it negates the scientific basis of parametric release itself

blocks.zh: Load Monitor 描述四面向：類型 (type)、使用與分析方法 (use and analysis)、測量功能 (functions measured)、位置理由 (rationale for location)；Class 5 為推薦標準
blocks.en: Four aspects of the Load Monitor description: Type, use and analysis, functions measured, and rationale for location; Class 5 is the recommended standard

blocks.zh: 送件途徑選擇：原始申請隨主件提交；已核准產品首次轉換須 Prior Approval Supplement；同場址同週期同類產品可走 Special Report/Annual Report
blocks.en: Choosing a filing pathway: An original application is submitted with the main filing; the first conversion of an approved product requires a Prior Approval Supplement; a similar product at the same site with the same cycle can follow a Special Report/Annual Report

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略：第一個產品以 PAS 建立寬廣的參數放行驗證基礎，後續相似產品走簡易途徑；初始驗證方案設計時即預留擴展空間
blocks.en: CDMO strategy: Establish a broad parametric release validation foundation with the first product through a PAS, and have subsequent similar products follow the simplified pathway; build room for expansion into the initial validation program design

blocks.zh: 核心參考文獻：PDA TR30（技術指引）、USP <1222>（藥典標準）、ICH Q9（風險方法）、PIC/S Annex 1（國際調和）構成參數放行的完整知識體系
blocks.en: Core references: PDA TR30 (technical guidance), USP <1222> (compendial standard), ICH Q9 (risk methodology), and PIC/S Annex 1 (international harmonization) together form the complete body of knowledge for parametric release
